summary: 2026-27 home kit. The club site's sponsors & partners footer (archived 2026-07-06) lists VTB (general sponsor per the club's partners page), Olimpbet, RVB (Wildberries&Russ), Transfin-M, Senezhskaya, Yandex Market, Pango Cars, Yandex Eda, Papa John's and Yandex PRO. On-jersey placements (front/sleeve/patch) for the 2026-27 KHL jersey could not be verified from a source readable by script, so every entry sits at 'partner' and sponsorsComplete stays false.
